    SELECT
        (
            ABS(
                (
                    market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'rsi14spot'
                )::NUMERIC - 50

                    market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'bbandspan'

        market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'bbandspan'

    ) AS technical_meter_direction,
    technical_signal_strength

    tech_signal_strength;
